'''CT-1008''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], he served under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] during the [[Battle of Phorose|battle]] of [[Phorose]]. Images of the battle taken from his [[clone-cam]] were used by [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Endaw N'gard'm]] while writing his report.
